title: Anchored Targeted Projection Pursuit — reference implementation and reproduction package
description:
Reference implementation of anchored targeted projection pursuit (anchored TPP), a closed-form, hyperparameter-free method for hypothesis-driven quality control of multivariate geochemical data from a small set of analyst-selected anchor samples.

The archive contains the NumPy core engine, the fully synthetic XRF core-scan benchmark generator, the semi-synthetic experiment pipeline, comparison baselines (PCA, single-element rules, minimum covariance determinant, isolation forest, one-class SVM, positive–unlabeled logistic regression), a 25-test suite, and one script per reported result.

Supplementary material for the article "Anchored Targeted Projection Pursuit: Hypothesis-Driven Quality Control of Multivariate Geochemical Data from Sparse Analyst Anchors", submitted to the Journal of Geo-Energy and Environment (ICCK).

Note on data: the semi-synthetic experiments require the published cuttings XRF dataset of Hall, B. (2018), CSEG Recorder. That dataset is third-party and is not redistributed here; it must be obtained from its original source. A synthetic stand-in generator is provided so the pipeline can be exercised without it.
